input_policy: Only the anonymous raw amino-acid sequence and general A106 instructions enter the episode.
evaluation_kind: quantitative microbial intervention candidate; numerical adequacy must be established
expected_findings: Resolve E. coli UppP/BacA while retaining actual strain, construct and residue correspondence.
Distinguish purified mutant phosphatase activity from functional complementation in the recipient background.
Preserve Table 2 mean, standard deviation and three individual experiments without inventing biological independence.
Keep the historical comparison measurements distinct; differences between studies are relevant to condition scope.
A quantitative endpoint and a complementation label alone do not establish fixed predictions or a likelihood model.
Use independently supported predictions, exact estimate variance and applicable model for any numerical ratio; otherwise return explicit missing operands.
Keep one original experiment identity across source tables, figures and paper representations.
limits: Candidate selection is not proof of a positive score. Expected findings are evaluation-only and must not be supplied to the autonomous episode.
